# GOG — March 2012 release announcement

- Original source: [Release: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood](https://www.gog.com/forum/general_archive/new_release_robin_hood_the_legend_of_sherwood/post15)
- Author / publication: GOG release announcement, preserved in its forum archive.
- Language / date: English; 2012-03-06.
- Access: Indexed announcement text inspected; discussion not exhaustively inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

GOG announces the game’s arrival on its service for a historical price of $9.99. The announcement emphasizes a DRM-free package with extras, a team of characters with distinct abilities, and infiltration, ambush, and castle-attack missions.

This documents a particular digital distribution milestone, separate from the original Windows release and later preservation changes. The price belongs to the 2012 announcement and is not a current offer. Its claims about atmosphere, authenticity, and quality are promotional judgments.
